selection.reason: Two same-age security posts provide a directional comparison only. Missing D+1 and D+7 observations, no matched three-sample treatment comparison, and no causal isolation. Older lifetime rankings are topic leads only.

experiment.control: Exact approved hero hook and current first evidence timing
experiment.mutation: Keep exact approved hook spoken and visible, but show one readable redacted proof/result within the first two seconds. Keep narration, duration, voice, captions and posting window matched when practical.
experiment.primaryOutcome: Same-platform provider-reported average watch time divided by measured video duration; this ratio is not a completion rate.
secondaryOutcomes: Shares and saves per view, with denominators
Clicks or follows only when available
experiment.decisionPolicy: At least three comparable posts per treatment and 15 percent median improvement; no promotion from this pair. Record D+1, D+3 and D+7 at their actual times; never backfill historical snapshots.
qualityConstraints: Exact approved hook and CTA preserved
Evidence labels and safe zones remain mandatory

limitations: Provider metrics can lag the network.
Views and X impressions are distinct metrics.
Current fitness report uses constant 50 for present watch data; it is not a retention rating. Do not use its composite as highest-rated video proof.
Snapshot averageViewDurationSeconds is derived from total watch time divided by views; raw averageTimeWatched differs.
No attribution for revenue, leads, causal creative effects or historical exact video bytes.
